description_expanded: OverviewHot TubNEWLY Renovated - Private Pool/Hot Tub, Nextdoor to Seaside, 5 Bikes - 'Beach Digs'The Space Old Seagrove Escape – Private Pool, Hot Tub & 5 Bikes Included! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Newly Renovated – Fresh furnishings & stylish vintage-coastal design Private Pool + Hot Tub – Relax and enjoy the Florida sun in your own backyard oasis 5 Bedrooms – 4 King Bedrooms + Loft, Sleeps 11 comfortably Open-Concept Living – Bright, spacious, and designed for gathering or relaxing Fully Stocked Kitchen – Perfect for family meals or entertaining Shaded Outdoor Lounge – Grill, dine, and unwind by the pool 5 Adult Cruiser Bikes – Explore Seaside, beach access, and 30A with ease Walk or Bike to Seaside – Minutes from shops, dining, and the Gulf Golf Cart Available – 6-seater rental option for easy cruising Family & Group Friendly – Ideal for multiple couples or families traveling together Welcome to Your Old Seagrove Beach Getaway Your perfect 30A vacation starts here! This newly remodeled 5-bedroom home in the heart of Old Seagrove blends laid-back coastal charm with plenty of space for everyone to spread out and relax. Whether you’re soaking in the hot tub, cooling off in the private pool, or biking into Seaside for a sunset dinner, you’ll be perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of 30A. Inside, you’ll find an airy open-concept living space filled with natural light, comfortable furnishings, and stylish touches throughout. The fully stocked kitchen makes cooking a breeze, whether it’s a seafood boil for the group or quick snacks after a day at the beach. Four king bedrooms and a loft space with additional sleeping make this home perfect for families and friends traveling together. Everyone gets a comfortable place to rest, with plenty of bathrooms and lounging areas to keep the vacation stress-free. Step outside to your private oasis featuring a sparkling pool, bubbling hot tub, grill, and shaded seating. Spend sunny afternoons lounging poolside, or take one of the five included cruiser bikes to explore Seaside and nearby beach access points. *Notification required one week prior to arrival to add pool heat *Pool heat max temperature is 87 degrees *Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st *Please note that we do not guarantee pool heat. This home has a pool alarm required by Florida law which cannot be disabled. Guests will be held responsible for any damage to the alarm. *To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old. -Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations -A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures. **Golf cart rental is not guaranteed. Should the golf cart need to be serviced a backup golf cart willnot be provided and no compensation will be given.** PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.** SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11): King Bedroom #1 – Private en suite King Bedroom #2 – Private en suite King Bedroom #3 – Shared bath King Bedroom #4 – Shared bath Loft Space – 1 Queen bed + 1 Twin bed (perfect for kids or teens), private en suite AREA ATTRACTIONS: Old Seagrove is a charming and centrally located 30A community, offering easy access to Seaside, Eastern Lake, and multiple public beach accesses. Bike to local shops, grab fresh seafood at Great Southern Café, or enjoy live music and Gulf views at Bud & Alley’s. With its peaceful neighborhood vibe and proximity to 30A’s most popular spots, Old Seagrove is the perfect base for your coastal getaway. Your Old Seagrove escape is ready to welcome you – just bring your flip-flops!Show less
